fixed: Saving an edit while Device Sync is running no longer waits for sync to read through your whole collection, which on a very large collection could take long enough for the save to fail with "database is locked". A save can still wait while sync applies changes from another device, and, rarely, while sync reads your collection again because a record was deleted or merged at the moment it was preparing what to share.

added: `CompendiumRepositories.readTransaction` runs a read-only action as one SQLite read transaction, without taking the write lock.
changed: `CompendiumSyncStorage.snapshot()` scans the library in a read transaction. Its writes, revalidating pending deletions and sweeping orphaned kept fields, run in short write transactions before and after the scan, and the sweep re-checks each record before it deletes. The returned snapshot is unchanged.
